entries.name: Falling rocks
entries.note: Dust trickles from the quarry wall, then a shadow marks where the rock will land. Body braces against the blow.

entries.name: Lightning
entries.note: The storm deck darkens overhead, then a ring of light marks the strike. Essence grounds it.

entries.name: Wind gusts
entries.note: Leaves and grit lift first, then the gust shoves everything downwind, off ledges too. Body holds its footing.

entries.name: Rapids current
entries.note: The shallows always pull downstream, and whitecaps warn of a surge. Body wades against it.

entries.name: Fog
entries.note: Mist pools at the ankles, then rolls over the slope. Blows go astray in it. Spirit sees through.

entries.name: Bitter cold
entries.note: Snow thickens before each freezing blast, which stiffens the limbs. Body endures it; a shrine gives shelter.

entries.name: Hollow puddles
entries.note: Grey water that drinks colour. It bubbles before grey threads rise from it. Spirit keeps the Hollow out.

entries.name: Thorn thickets
entries.note: Old thorn canes hide in the bamboo. Walking through them tears skin. Body shrugs them off.

entries.name: Scorching heat
entries.note: The air shimmers, then the full weight of the sun lands and blows go soft. Essence keeps the body cool; shrines give shade.

entries.name: Sandstorm
entries.note: A brown wall rises on the horizon, then it shoves and blinds. Body stands in it.

entries.name: Quicksand
entries.note: The sand swirls before it swallows. Agility keeps the feet moving.

entries.name: Spike traps
entries.note: Grit shivers over a pressure plate before bronze spikes spring from the floor. Agility gets the feet clear.

entries.name: Poison mist
entries.note: The bandits vent marsh gas through the tunnels: the vents hiss before they breathe. Body tolerates the poison.
